rules.title: Account protection rules
rules.super_admin: The super administrator cannot be deactivated or deleted — they ensure an administrator is always present.
rules.self: No user can deactivate or delete their own account.
rules.admin_admin: An administrator can neither deactivate nor delete another administrator — only the super administrator has that right. Otherwise, super admin and admin have identical powers.
rules.totp: 2FA reset is reserved for the super administrator for admin accounts; administrators can only reset 2FA for standard users.
